'''Humans''' are the starting path in Vampire Life, and the only one that is safe in daylight.


== Overview ==
* '''Starting weapon:''' Fists
* '''Starting level:''' Lv 0
* '''Daylight:''' Safe — no sun damage
* '''Blood meter:''' None
* '''Fun fact:''' Human is the only path with a stat tree


== Playstyle ==
Humans progress through villager quests, notice-board bounties, and hunting. Cash earned from quests buys better weapons, and bounties pay for kills — reported examples include KILL 20 NPCS IN CITY (70 XP + $50) and KILL 5 GUARDS (55 XP + $60).


== Weapons ==
* '''Fists''' — starting weapon
* '''Wooden stake''' — early weapon, punishes close-range vampires
* '''Flintlock''' — ranged hunting weapon
* '''Shotgun''' — fires wooden pellets, 8 rounds, headshot decapitation (⚠️ price reported as both $900 and $600 on the same cached Trello board)


== Turning ==
Humans can turn and choose between three races: Witch, Vampire, and Werewolf. For the vampire-turning sequence, see [[Beginner Guide#How Turning Works]]. If you don't like the race you chose, buy a Human Potion from the merchant at the first village for 50 in-game money to revert back to Human.

== Sub-Races ==
Part of the human tree, this sub-race has its own page:
* [[Vampire Hunter]] — become one by completing the Vampire Hunter quest at the windmill tower near the Merchant in front of the Vampire Castle (must be Human).


== Strengths and Weaknesses ==
* '''Strengths:''' Daylight freedom, no feeding upkeep, strong early quest income, hunter toolkit
* '''Weaknesses:''' No supernatural abilities; highest skill ceiling of any path — leveling up your stats takes time
